model_name: trial-14 ControlModel generator + K562+CD4 same-target transfer a=0.197x2.5
description: Cells are generated by a model fitted on each context's own control cells: PCA of the highly variable genes, a new state sampled near an observed one, the composition decoded as the mean of the 30 nearest control cells, and per-gene Gamma-Poisson dispersion matched to the controls' zero fractions. No control cell is copied into the prediction. With no predicted effect this generator makes a median of 0 significant genes per perturbation against held-out controls of the same context. The predicted effect of a target is a reliability-weighted mean of its measured CRISPRi response in K562 genome-wide Perturb-seq (Replogle et al. 2022, weight 0.43) and primary CD4+ T cells (GSE314342 pseudobulk, donor-matched controls, weight 0.57), each source's mean response removed, scaled by 0.197 and then by 2.5: the amplitude was chosen by a rule written before the pilots, as the smallest giving a median of at least 60 significant genes per perturbation in every context. No perturbed cell of the official contexts is used.
